items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Ship beta for agentic code review, fixes, and policy-based approvals
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 測試版，讓代理審查、修復並依政策核准程式碼
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Ship in beta on November 23 for Team and Enterprise plans on GitHub. It combines the generally available Code Review with two beta agents (PR Steward and Claude Approvals) so Claude can review pull requests, fix issues such as failing CI or merge conflicts, and approve routine changes according to a team-written policy file. Teams retain control over where it runs and which changes require human sign-off; the /ship command is available in Claude Code.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 11 月 23 日宣布 Claude Ship 測試版，適用於 Team 與 Enterprise 方案的 GitHub 儲存庫。它結合已全面可用的 Code Review 與兩個測試中代理（PR Steward 與 Claude Approvals），讓 Claude 審查拉取請求、修復失敗的 CI 或合併衝突等問題，並依團隊撰寫的政策檔核准常規變更。團隊仍掌控執行範圍與需人工簽署的變更；Claude Code 提供 /ship 指令。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic coding from generation into the review-and-merge loop, addressing a growing bottleneck as AI writes more code. The key uncertainty is how reliably policy-based approvals catch subtle defects in AI-generated changes without increasing risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理編碼從生成推進到審查與合併環節，解決 AI 撰寫更多程式碼後的瓶頸。關鍵不確定性在於基於政策的核准能否可靠捕捉 AI 生成變更中的細微缺陷，而不增加風險。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now review pull requests, fix them, and approve the ones that a team's policy allows. The goal: ship code as fast as teams write it.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 現在可以審查拉取請求、修復它們，並核准團隊政策允許的那些。目標：以團隊撰寫程式碼的速度交付程式碼。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls GPT-6.2 (Sol-tuned) into ChatGPT Chat tab for paid tiers
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-6.2（Sol 調校版）推至 ChatGPT 聊天分頁付費層級
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out a chat-optimized version of GPT-6.2 on November 23 to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab. It reports gains in image understanding (71.7% vs 47.4% for GPT-6), instruction following, expert-level tasks, and web browsing on internal evals, plus improved teen-safety policy compliance. The models powering Work and Codex are unchanged; Enterprise availability depends on admin settings.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 23 日開始向 Plus、Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 層級的聊天分頁推出聊天優化版 GPT-6.2。它在內部評估中報告影像理解（71.7% 對 GPT-6 的 47.4%）、指令遵循、專家級任務與網頁瀏覽的提升，以及青少年安全政策合規改善。驅動 Work 與 Codex 的模型未改變；Enterprise 可用性取決於管理員設定。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bringing the newest Sol variant into the main chat surface narrows the gap between flagship capabilities and everyday use. Actual user-facing gains will depend on rollout speed and whether the reported eval improvements hold outside OpenAI’s tests.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將最新 Sol 變體帶入主要聊天介面，縮小旗艦能力與日常使用的差距。實際使用者端增益取決於推出速度，以及報告的評估改進是否在 OpenAI 測試外仍成立。
items_flat.quote: GPT‑6.2 starts rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers today in the Chat tab.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT‑6.2 今天開始在聊天分頁向全球 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 層級推出。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind Gemini 4 agent teams cut quantum algorithm costs with Lean formal verification
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 代理團隊與 Lean 形式驗證降低量子演算法成本
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI reported on November 23 that teams of Gemini 4 agents improved known quantum algorithms, with results formally verified in Lean. Reported gains include 11.8× lower combined cost for an inertial-confinement fusion calculation (memory from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits), 8× for a photochemistry molecule, 2.5× for Cytochrome P450, 2.57× for a Grover search implementation, and 290× for an arcsin arithmetic routine. The Lean library and verified solutions were open-sourced.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與 Google Quantum AI 於 11 月 23 日報告，Gemini 4 代理團隊改善已知量子演算法，結果以 Lean 形式驗證。報告的增益包括慣性約束融合計算的綜合成本降低 11.8 倍（記憶體從 5,650 降至 4,338 個錯誤更正量子位元）、光化學分子 8 倍、細胞色素 P450 2.5 倍、Grover 搜尋實作 2.57 倍，以及 arcsin 算術常式 290 倍。Lean 函式庫與已驗證解法已開源。
items_flat.analysis_en: Pairing agent search with machine-checked proofs lets the lab claim large resource reductions on circuits too big to simulate classically. Whether these estimates translate to near-term quantum hardware remains uncertain, as the work is still at the formal-resource stage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將代理搜尋與機器檢查證明配對，讓實驗室能在過大而無法經典模擬的電路上主張大幅資源削減。這些估計是否能轉化為近期量子硬體仍不確定，因為工作仍處於形式資源階段。
items_flat.quote: Our agent teams cut the required computing cost ... by 11.8×, and lowered required memory from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的代理團隊將所需運算成本降低 11.8 倍，並將所需記憶體從 5,650 降至 4,338 個錯誤更正量子位元。

items_flat.title_en: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok-generated non-consensual and child sexual images
items_flat.title_zh: 維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州起訴 SpaceX，涉 Grok 生成非同意與兒童性影像
items_flat.summary_en: On November 23, Virginia and Oregon filed separate state-court lawsuits against SpaceX (and related entities) alleging that Grok’s image features, including “spicy mode,” generated non-consensual sexualized images of adults and children while the company promoted the product as safe. The states cite consumer-protection laws and seek damages, penalties, and orders to stop the alleged practices. A cited study estimated millions of sexualized images posted on X, including thousands appearing to depict children.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 23 日，維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州在州法院分別起訴 SpaceX（及相關實體），指控 Grok 的影像功能（包括「spicy mode」）生成成人與兒童的非同意性化影像，同時公司宣傳產品安全。兩州援引消費者保護法，尋求損害賠償、罰款與停止涉案行為的命令。引用的研究估計 X 上發布了數百萬張性化影像，其中包括數千張看似描繪兒童的影像。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are the first state-level suits specifically targeting Grok’s image safeguards after earlier investigations. Outcomes will turn on whether courts find the company’s safety representations and controls inadequate under state consumer laws; SpaceX has previously said users violated terms of service.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些是針對 Grok 影像防護的首批州級訴訟，此前已有調查。結果取決於法院是否認定公司的安全表述與控制在州消費者法下不足；SpaceX 先前表示使用者違反服務條款。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and president
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 董事會一致恢復黃仁勳任執行長與總裁
items_flat.summary_en: On November 23, NVIDIA’s board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and a board member, effective immediately, 11 days after his resignation. The board said it held discussions with Huang, received input from senior U.S. government levels, and concluded the reinstatement poses no national security risk. Interim CEO Colette Kress returns to CFO; an independent investigation continues.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 23 日，NVIDIA 董事會一致恢復共同創辦人黃仁勳任總裁、執行長與董事，立即生效，距其辭職 11 天。董事會表示與黃仁勳進行討論、收到美國政府高層意見，並認定恢復不構成國家安全風險。臨時執行長 Colette Kress 恢復財務長職務；獨立調查持續進行。
items_flat.analysis_en: Huang’s return stabilizes leadership at the dominant AI-chip supplier after a brief, high-profile interruption. The stock reaction was sharply positive, but the underlying allegations and ongoing investigation remain open issues for governance and export-control oversight.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 黃仁勳的回歸穩定了主導 AI 晶片供應商的領導層，在短暫高調中斷之後。股價反應強烈正面，但潛在指控與持續調查仍是治理與出口管制監督的開放議題。
items_flat.quote: The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 董事會相信黃仁勳是領導 NVIDIA 的正確人選，且其恢復符合股東、員工、合作夥伴與客戶的最佳利益。

items_flat.title_en: Google adds native file-slicing controls to the Gemini API for Gemini 4 models
items_flat.title_zh: Google 為 Gemini API 新增原生檔案切片控制，適用 Gemini 4 模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on November 23 that the Gemini API now supports server-side file slicing for PDFs, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument files, audio, and video. Developers can request specific pages, spreadsheet ranges, or media segments; tokens are billed only for the parts Gemini inspects. The feature works across Gemini 4 models in AI Studio and the Gemini platform, with existing upload limits still applying.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 23 日宣布，Gemini API 現在支援 PDF、Microsoft Office、OpenDocument 檔案、音訊與影片的伺服器端檔案切片。開發者可請求特定頁面、試算表範圍或媒體區段；僅對 Gemini 檢查的部分計費代幣。此功能適用於 AI Studio 與 Gemini 平台的 Gemini 4 模型，現有上傳限制仍適用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Slicing reduces token cost and local preprocessing for long documents and media, which is useful for agent workflows. The practical savings depend on how well developers (or agents) choose slices and on whether the model’s quality on partial inputs matches full-file performance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 切片降低長文件與媒體的代幣成本與本地預處理，對代理工作流程有用。實際節省取決於開發者（或代理）選擇切片的能力，以及模型在部分輸入上的品質是否與完整檔案相當。
items_flat.quote: This keeps context focused on the relevant parts of a file while billing tokens only for the parts Gemini inspects.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這讓上下文聚焦於檔案的相關部分，同時僅對 Gemini 檢查的部分計費代幣。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent for UK adults on app, web, and WhatsApp
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在英國向成人推出 Muse 個人 AI 代理，支援應用程式、網頁與 WhatsApp
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced on November 23–24 that Muse is available to people 18 and older in the UK on iOS, Android, muse.ai, and WhatsApp. Users can connect apps and websites; Muse asks before sending email or making purchases, cannot see passwords or card details, and shows its actions. UK retail and travel partners include Marks & Spencer, Sainsbury’s, Currys, and easyJet. Most use is free; optional paid plans exist without listed prices.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 23–24 日宣布，Muse 在英國向 18 歲以上人士開放，支援 iOS、Android、muse.ai 與 WhatsApp。使用者可連接應用程式與網站；Muse 在發送電子郵件或購物前會詢問、無法看到密碼或卡號細節，並顯示其動作。英國零售與旅遊合作夥伴包括馬莎百貨、Sainsbury’s、Currys 與 easyJet。多數使用免費；存在可選付費方案但未列出價格。
items_flat.analysis_en: The UK launch expands Muse beyond the US while regulators (CMA, ICO) have engaged on consumer protection. The practical test will be how reliably the agent completes multi-step tasks with local partners without overstepping user controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 英國上線將 Muse 擴展至美國以外，同時監管機構（CMA、ICO）已就消費者保護介入。實際考驗在於代理能否可靠地與本地合作夥伴完成多步驟任務，而不越權。
items_flat.quote: Muse is available to anyone aged 18 and over in the UK from today on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse 從今天起在英國向 18 歲以上任何人開放，支援 iOS、Android、muse.ai 與 WhatsApp。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Cisco open-source Shirudo eBPF runtime for temporary Linux shields
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Cisco 開源 Shirudo eBPF 執行環境，提供臨時 Linux 防護
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and Cisco announced Shirudo on November 23, an open-source Linux runtime that lets agents write dynamic eBPF “shields” to block exploit behavior on running systems without restarts or downtime. Operators approve shields before deployment; the project is pre-release and currently needs a specially patched kernel. A controlled test showed a Codex-generated shield blocking a Java4Shell attempt against Elasticsearch.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Cisco 於 11 月 23 日宣布 Shirudo，這是一個開源 Linux 執行環境，讓代理撰寫動態 eBPF「防護」以在運行中系統上阻擋漏洞利用行為，無需重新啟動或停機。操作員在部署前核准防護；專案為預發布版，目前需要特別修補的核心。受控測試顯示由 Codex 生成的防護阻擋了針對 Elasticsearch 的 Java4Shell 嘗試。
items_flat.analysis_en: Shirudo targets the window between vulnerability disclosure and full patching by enabling temporary, reversible kernel-level controls. Adoption will depend on kernel requirements, operator trust in agent-generated shields, and how widely the open-source project is hardened.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Shirudo 針對漏洞揭露與完整修補之間的窗口，透過啟用臨時、可逆的核心層控制。採用將取決於核心需求、操作員對代理生成防護的信任，以及開源專案的強化程度。
items_flat.quote: An open-source runtime that helps operators protect running Linux systems without needing to wait for the patch or restarts.
items_flat.quote_zh: 一個開源執行環境，幫助操作員保護運行中的 Linux 系統，無需等待修補或重新啟動。

google.summary_en: Google announced on November 23 that the Gemini API now supports server-side file slicing for PDFs, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument files, audio, and video. Developers can request specific pages, spreadsheet ranges, or media segments; tokens are billed only for the parts Gemini inspects. The feature works across Gemini 4 models in AI Studio and the Gemini platform, with existing upload limits still applying.
google.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 23 日宣布，Gemini API 現在支援 PDF、Microsoft Office、OpenDocument 檔案、音訊與影片的伺服器端檔案切片。開發者可請求特定頁面、試算表範圍或媒體區段；僅對 Gemini 檢查的部分計費代幣。此功能適用於 AI Studio 與 Gemini 平台的 Gemini 4 模型，現有上傳限制仍適用。
google.analysis_en: Slicing reduces token cost and local preprocessing for long documents and media, which is useful for agent workflows. The practical savings depend on how well developers (or agents) choose slices and on whether the model’s quality on partial inputs matches full-file performance.
google.analysis_zh: 切片降低長文件與媒體的代幣成本與本地預處理，對代理工作流程有用。實際節省取決於開發者（或代理）選擇切片的能力，以及模型在部分輸入上的品質是否與完整檔案相當。
google.quote: This keeps context focused on the relevant parts of a file while billing tokens only for the parts Gemini inspects.
google.quote_zh: 這讓上下文聚焦於檔案的相關部分，同時僅對 Gemini 檢查的部分計費代幣。

meta.title_en: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent for UK adults on app, web, and WhatsApp
meta.title_zh: Meta 在英國向成人推出 Muse 個人 AI 代理，支援應用程式、網頁與 WhatsApp
meta.summary_en: Meta announced on November 23–24 that Muse is available to people 18 and older in the UK on iOS, Android, muse.ai, and WhatsApp. Users can connect apps and websites; Muse asks before sending email or making purchases, cannot see passwords or card details, and shows its actions. UK retail and travel partners include Marks & Spencer, Sainsbury’s, Currys, and easyJet. Most use is free; optional paid plans exist without listed prices.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 23–24 日宣布，Muse 在英國向 18 歲以上人士開放，支援 iOS、Android、muse.ai 與 WhatsApp。使用者可連接應用程式與網站；Muse 在發送電子郵件或購物前會詢問、無法看到密碼或卡號細節，並顯示其動作。英國零售與旅遊合作夥伴包括馬莎百貨、Sainsbury’s、Currys 與 easyJet。多數使用免費；存在可選付費方案但未列出價格。
meta.analysis_en: The UK launch expands Muse beyond the US while regulators (CMA, ICO) have engaged on consumer protection. The practical test will be how reliably the agent completes multi-step tasks with local partners without overstepping user controls.
meta.analysis_zh: 英國上線將 Muse 擴展至美國以外，同時監管機構（CMA、ICO）已就消費者保護介入。實際考驗在於代理能否可靠地與本地合作夥伴完成多步驟任務，而不越權。
meta.quote: Muse is available to anyone aged 18 and over in the UK from today on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp.
meta.quote_zh: Muse 從今天起在英國向 18 歲以上任何人開放，支援 iOS、Android、muse.ai 與 WhatsApp。

xai.title_en: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok-generated non-consensual and child sexual images
xai.title_zh: 維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州起訴 SpaceX，涉 Grok 生成非同意與兒童性影像
xai.summary_en: On November 23, Virginia and Oregon filed separate state-court lawsuits against SpaceX (and related entities) alleging that Grok’s image features, including “spicy mode,” generated non-consensual sexualized images of adults and children while the company promoted the product as safe. The states cite consumer-protection laws and seek damages, penalties, and orders to stop the alleged practices. A cited study estimated millions of sexualized images posted on X, including thousands appearing to depict children.
xai.summary_zh: 11 月 23 日，維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州在州法院分別起訴 SpaceX（及相關實體），指控 Grok 的影像功能（包括「spicy mode」）生成成人與兒童的非同意性化影像，同時公司宣傳產品安全。兩州援引消費者保護法，尋求損害賠償、罰款與停止涉案行為的命令。引用的研究估計 X 上發布了數百萬張性化影像，其中包括數千張看似描繪兒童的影像。
xai.analysis_en: These are the first state-level suits specifically targeting Grok’s image safeguards after earlier investigations. Outcomes will turn on whether courts find the company’s safety representations and controls inadequate under state consumer laws; SpaceX has previously said users violated terms of service.
xai.analysis_zh: 這些是針對 Grok 影像防護的首批州級訴訟，此前已有調查。結果取決於法院是否認定公司的安全表述與控制在州消費者法下不足；SpaceX 先前表示使用者違反服務條款。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and president
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 董事會一致恢復黃仁勳任執行長與總裁
frontier_other.summary_en: On November 23, NVIDIA’s board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and a board member, effective immediately, 11 days after his resignation. The board said it held discussions with Huang, received input from senior U.S. government levels, and concluded the reinstatement poses no national security risk. Interim CEO Colette Kress returns to CFO; an independent investigation continues.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 11 月 23 日，NVIDIA 董事會一致恢復共同創辦人黃仁勳任總裁、執行長與董事，立即生效，距其辭職 11 天。董事會表示與黃仁勳進行討論、收到美國政府高層意見，並認定恢復不構成國家安全風險。臨時執行長 Colette Kress 恢復財務長職務；獨立調查持續進行。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Huang’s return stabilizes leadership at the dominant AI-chip supplier after a brief, high-profile interruption. The stock reaction was sharply positive, but the underlying allegations and ongoing investigation remain open issues for governance and export-control oversight.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 黃仁勳的回歸穩定了主導 AI 晶片供應商的領導層，在短暫高調中斷之後。股價反應強烈正面，但潛在指控與持續調查仍是治理與出口管制監督的開放議題。
frontier_other.quote: The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 董事會相信黃仁勳是領導 NVIDIA 的正確人選，且其恢復符合股東、員工、合作夥伴與客戶的最佳利益。

brief_en: Anthropic shipped Claude Ship for agentic PR review/fix/approve; OpenAI rolled GPT-6.2 into ChatGPT Chat tab and open-sourced Shirudo shields with Cisco; DeepMind used Gemini agents + Lean to cut quantum algorithm costs up to 290x; Meta launched Muse agent in the UK; Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX over Grok images; NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.
brief_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 讓代理審查、修復並依政策核准 PR；OpenAI 將 GPT-6.2 推至 ChatGPT 聊天分頁並與 Cisco 開源 Shirudo 防護；DeepMind 用 Gemini 代理＋Lean 將量子演算法成本最多降 290 倍；Meta 在英國上線 Muse 代理；維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州起訴 SpaceX 涉 Grok 影像；NVIDIA 恢復黃仁勳任執行長。
